meta.src: IAU / Sky & Telescope constellation figures (MacRobert, Sinnott & Fienberg 2008), as digitised in Stellarium's modern_iau sky culture (github.com/Stellarium/stellarium, skycultures/modern_iau/index.json, master 1ea9d5f6, fetched 2026-10-14, SHA-256 2b7aa4fa2860566e…), CC BY-SA 4.0; stars from stars.json (HYG v4.4, CC BY-SA 4.0)

rules.tone: Wien peak lowered 40 octaves (GALAXY.starVoice f0); body by luminosity class; timbre: its 3 strongest line filters (GALAXY.filters), or its line chord (GALAXY.lineChord, 6 strongest, gamma 1.25) in the Spectral-lines mode
rules.xy: azimuthal equidistant about the figure's centre, degrees, x east-to-the-left (as seen), y north
rules.tr: strokes of star indices; a stroke after the first starts at a star already heard (a branch) or the nearest unvisited one

meta.voice: f0 the Wien tone (Hz, 40 octaves down); kind the luminosity kind (body: kinds[kind] = [sub, sub2, h2, h3, h5, odd, lp×f0, saw0], saw = saw0 + 0.1 × clamp(.25 + log10(T/3000)/2.4, 0, 1)); t the class table: tables[t].fl = 3 timbre filters [line nm, gain dB, Q] folded about f0 (GALAXY.foldLine), tables[t].ch = the 6 strongest lines of its line chord [Hz, amplitude]; rgb its true colour; br breathing (Hz), vr rotation vibrato (Hz), vd its depth (cents) — all from galaxy.js (con_voices.mjs)
